title: Shock (circulatory)
scenario: Person is pale, cold, clammy, sweaty, weak, breathing fast, dizzy or confused after an injury, bleeding, or burn.
steps: Treat the obvious cause you can see, such as firm pressure on heavy bleeding.
Lay the person flat on their back.
If no leg, spine, or head injury, raise their legs about 12 inches on a bag or cushion.
Keep them warm: blanket or coats under and over them.
Loosen tight clothing. Keep them calm and still until help arrives.
do_not: Nothing to eat or drink, even if they ask.
Do not raise the legs if a leg, spine, or head injury is suspected.
